purpose: test whether capytaine's mesh-independent deviation from the multipole reference is caused by the near-field singular-term quadrature choice (gf_singularities), i.e. an artefact of the third-party code rather than a property of the reference
case: radius 1.0 m, submergence 2.0 m, rho 1025, g 9.80665, infinite depth, ka=1.0
conclusion: the two settings agree to the printed precision (4 decimals of a percent), so the residual deviation of capytaine from the multipole reference is not a near-field-integral singularity artifact; it is the discretisation error of capytaine's flat-panel solution and decays with refinement
